For applicants
Open calls
Twice a year, you can apply for enrolment and a faculty fellowship. You apply with your own PhD project. Find the timeline and further information about the application process.
Predefined PhD projects
Through out the year, we advertise predefined PhD projects. Predefined projects are fully financed and main supervisors advertise the project to find a candiate. Find vacant projects here.
Graduate Programmes
Health offers graduate programmes within Biomedicine, Clinical Medicine, Forensic Medicine, Odontology and Public Health.
Doing a PhD at Aarhus University
Find more information about what it is like to do a PhD at AU
You need to be approved for enrolment in order to start as a PhD student. The consideration and assessment of your application for enrolment takes place pursuant to:
The PhD order (ph.d-bekendtgørelsen, in Danish)
The PhD order (in English)
All PhD students also need to be employed. Employment takes place pursuant to:
The Appointment Order (Ansættelsesbekendtgørelsen)
SU - The Danish Students' Grants and Loans Scheme
Research Year
You can apply for a research year twice a year. See the timeline and find more information about the application process.
